title: Spicy Grilled Veggie Skewers
description: A flavorful and colorful vegan dish, perfect for summer. The bold flavors of the spices complement the natural sweetness of the vegetables.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Cut the bell peppers, onions, zucchini, and mushrooms into 1-inch pieces.
In a small bowl, mix together the spicy croatian pepper and olive oil.
Brush the pepper mixture onto both sides of the vegetables.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the vegetables during the last minute of grilling.
